scope: Three selected p5-only capability slices; no full-corpus certification.

cases.fidelity: structural/technique; explicit different random stream and byte conversion
cases.renderer: p5 Canvas2D, 600x800, pixelDensity1, encoded-sRGB straight ARGB8 transport
cases.determinism: geometry seed42 and grain rngState42 in separate streams; no frame or clock input
cases.mapping: 24x7 blocks at30+i*80,40+j*30;8x2 cells of5 pixels on9-pixel pitch,30% skips; background24 and fill200 alpha180; RGB_ADD grain range[0,10],exponent1
intentional_differences: Explicit LCG32 rather than Processing random; independent geometry/grain streams
Round-to-nearest changed byte rather than Processing float color conversion
acceptance: Browser executes actual public operation without errors
Canvas dimensions and selected stored frame coverage match
tools/benchmark.py default portable-deterministic profile passes, with all raw metrics retained
Root directly inspects baseline and candidate: block arrangement, missing-cell texture and fine brightness grain remain visible
Strength edit changes pixels without changing geometry; reset/reload exact; save does not redraw
cases.limits: No exact source pixel identity; failed visual gates remain failed and cannot be renamed into demonstrated coverage. Alpha-layer study is separate and does not recreate quadShadow's per-fragment scheduling.

cases.fidelity: Technique component in independent composition, not original recreation. Chosen before rendering.
cases.native_study: field-displacement: retained regularly sampled grid lines and circle rims; paired existing portable gradient samples; Cartesian/polar display toggle and gain edit.
acceptance: Exact/error shared fixtures and passive ownership checks
Actual p5 Canvas2D renders returned points in order
Gain edit changes geometry while source count/connectivity and palette remain fixed
Reset/reload exact, PNG save without redraw
Root inspects original references and native baseline/edit; record declared sampler/composition differences
cases.limits: No original-image benchmark or demonstrated original claim. Source value-noise/simplex, sequential query feedback and whole-scene artwork are not implemented by this conversion.

cases.fidelity: Technique dependency in independent field-sized dot composition. No original scene recreation. Chosen before code/render.
cases.native_study: octave-noise: fixed2D dot positions sampled by existing portable2D gradient profile; baseline1 versus5 octaves, independent persistence and normalization edits.
acceptance: Actual p5Canvas2D uses returned values for mark sizes
Octave/persistence/normalization edits visibly change scalar-size pattern while positions/count/seed fixed
Root source/native image inspection and withheld source transfer recorded
cases.limits: No original-image benchmark, original scene or exact Processing noise claim. Field accumulates untransformed existinggradient values only.
